MVP.title: Most Valuable Player
MVP.past_note: Each winner's final per-game numbers and his team's record.
MVP.note: Preseason: last season's numbers shown; chances simulate a full season from them. Chances come from a model fitted on every winner since 2002-03. Each candidate's season is simulated to the end (numbers so far, last season's level, games he is likely to play, his team's record), and from 2023-24 players who cannot reach 65 games are out. In a replay of 2010-2026, favourites in the first quarter of the season (about 47% shown on average) won about a third of the time; later the chances were about right. Pool: top 25 by box-score production.
MVP.empty: The season has not started; chances appear after the first games.
